I told Hollis in a thread in #central-team that the site is Gate 47. Pree posted Dock 23 in that channel on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because she'd read the wrong line. Nobody in the channel has changed it since.

I couldn't check the knowledge brain first: it refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. The answer comes only from #central-team, which I confirmed Hollis belongs to.

To fix the brain, an admin needs to run this on the brain host, with the member it should serve:

    gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<member>'

The brain's error message also describes setting it up to act for several members.
